purpose: Domain-shifted candidate holdouts for deciding whether upgraded Agents deserve expert status. Package and prompt checks cannot satisfy this gate.
evaluatorIndependence: The main agent authors and grades these holdouts because no independent evaluator surface is available. Every score must cite exact output evidence; passing one case is necessary but not sufficient for production qualification.

qualificationRule.minimumPerCase: All hard assertions pass; no material hallucination; requested length and execution boundaries pass.
qualificationRule.productionRule: A single passing candidate sample does not qualify an expert. Repeated domain-shifted normal, correction, retry, revision and reopen evidence is required.

evals.title: 触发前草稿、责任更正与回执边界
evals.prompt:
请把下面记录整理成一张可直接跟进的行动表。不要调用工具、创建任务或猜绝对日期，全文不超过 520 字。

08:50 记录：法务批准后 6 小时内，由李乔发布合作方通知，赵乔复核附件。
09:05 更正：姓名记反了，发布人应为赵乔，李乔只复核附件；其他条件不变。
09:20 赵乔已提交通知草稿和 2 个附件，完整包应有 5 个附件；法务尚未批准。
09:30 林溪说“也许可以提前提醒经销商”，没有人承诺执行。
09:40 系统回执显示“通知草稿已接收”，没有发布回执。

必须区分有效责任、被替代记录、建议、行动状态和证据状态。
assertions: 赵乔 is the only active publisher and 李乔 is only the reviewer; the earlier reversed assignment is explicitly superseded.
The publication obligation is waiting for legal approval, not in progress, even though a draft exists.
The deadline remains approval plus six hours and no absolute time is invented.
Two of five attachments and draft receipt are partial evidence, not publication or completion.
The dealer reminder remains an uncommitted suggestion; the whole answer is one followable table within 520 Chinese characters and performs no external action.

evals.title: 发票规则、字段权限与批处理验收评审
evals.prompt:
仅按下面题面做需求评审，不调用工具，不补充 UI、接口路由、HTTP 状态码、缓存、工具名、完成时限或数值阈值。全文不超过 800 字。

P1：每个已支付订单必须且只能存在一张有效发票。
P2：原发票作废后，财务经理可重开；客服不能重开。
P3：客服可以查看发票状态和脱敏税号，即使客服同时是订单协作者，也不能查看完整税号。
P4：发票归档年限待定，候选 5 年或 10 年。
P5：同一开票 requestId 重试不得产生第二张有效发票。
P6：批量核对预计覆盖 10 万至 80 万订单，需求只写“应快速完成”。

请判断真正冲突与待决项，说明哪些规则不应被 P4 阻塞，并为唯一性/重开、字段权限、幂等和性能给出可测试验收口径。
assertions: P1 and P2 are reconciled through valid-versus-void state rather than reported as a superficial conflict.
P4 remains a retention decision and does not block invoice uniqueness, reissue authorization, field masking or idempotency invariants.
The authorization oracle checks role, invoice state and exact visible fields, not only record counts.
Idempotency uses the same requestId and verifies authoritative invoice identity plus the count of valid invoices or issuance side effects.

Performance keeps scale, timing boundaries, statistic and threshold as measurable requirements while leaving the missing threshold undecided; no forbidden implementation detail is invented and the answer stays within 800 characters.

evals.title: 权益领取原子性、恢复与撤销竞态测试
evals.prompt:
为下面机制设计精简的高风险测试。不要执行测试、调用工具或假设接口状态码。

权益钱包保存 version 与 remaining。claim(walletId, amount, expectedVersion, operationKey) 仅在 expectedVersion 等于当前 version 且余额足够时，原子扣减 remaining 并将 version 加一；同一 operationKey 重试不得重复扣减。服务可能在持久化前、持久化后但响应前、响应后崩溃。revoke(operationKey) 可能与 claim 完成并发。

必须覆盖：同一预读基线的并发领取、原子操作前同步屏障、过期请求、三个崩溃窗口、撤销/完成两种先后；每项给出权威观察和允许/禁止状态。所有用例标为“设计完成、未执行”。
assertions: Both claimers first capture the same expected version, synchronize immediately before the indivisible compare-and-update, and at most one advances the wallet.
The test does not split the atomic compare from its write or require both operations to observe the old version inside the atomic section.
A stale expectedVersion cannot decrement remaining or advance version.
The three crash windows preserve complete old or complete new state as permitted, and retry after persisted-before-response causes no second deduction.
Revoke-first and claim-first orderings have authoritative wallet, operation and effect evidence; every case is explicitly designed but unexecuted and no status code is invented.
